$note: Your numbers, for projecting pipeline from LinkedIn activity. Every value here is an input you control — nothing is inferred and nothing is guessed. Leave a figure at 0 and the dashboard reports 'not set' rather than inventing one.

$guidance.averageDealValueUsd: Typical first engagement with a new Microns client. Set this and the projection becomes real.
$guidance.grossMarginPercent: Rough delivery margin, so the projection is profit and not revenue.
$guidance.conversationToCallRate: Share of qualified inbound conversations that become a booked call. 0.4 is a starting assumption; it is overwritten by your recorded numbers as soon as you have some.
$guidance.callToDealRate: Share of booked calls that close. 0.2 is a starting assumption; likewise overwritten by real data.
